_style: Photorealistic commercial photograph of a real installed city fence, sunny autumn day, clear blue sky, natural daylight with crisp shadows, granite paving. The fence must match the reference image exactly: same design, proportions and the same brown polymer powder-coated square steel tubes. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no people.

detail.prompt: Close-up photo of this exact fence section: the center where the middle vertical post, the top horizontal rail and the diagonal cross braces meet. The whole frame looks like ONE monolithic solid piece: welds are fully ground flush and invisible, no seams, no gaps, no lines, no overlaps between members, no bolts, no screws, no plates. Every tube has crisp straight edges and perfectly smooth, even, glossy-satin brown polymer powder coating that flows continuously across the joints. Shallow depth of field, blurred city square in the background. Joint placed in the middle of the vertical frame.

row.prompt: Wide photo of FOUR separate, identical free-standing fence sections exactly like the reference, standing one after another in a straight line along the edge of a paved city square, in front of a lawn and flower bed. Each section is an independent mobile unit with its own two vertical end posts on flat steel base feet (skids), exactly like the reference. There is a clear visible gap of about 20-30 cm between neighbouring sections; sections are NOT welded, NOT connected and do NOT share posts. Perspective view along the line, sections recede into the distance, trees and modern buildings behind. Sections occupy the middle and lower part of the vertical frame, sky in the upper part.
